rule Detect_WannaCry_Payload {
    meta:
        description = "Detects WannaCry variant based on static indicators"
        author = "SOC Team"
        hash = "a5c063c1"
    strings:
        $s1 = "WNcry@2ol7" fullword ascii
        $s2 = { 60 00 00 00 47 4B 53 46 00 00 00 00 } // GSKF header
    condition:
        $s1 and $s2
}
